verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS that holds sensitive founder and company data, so letting users choose a data-storage region is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any data-residency or region selection. The docs cover only incorporation jurisdiction (Delaware) and founders' home countries, which is a different matter from where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
